text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh— Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. You are my...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Elder Sister.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. You're tough, you know 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I am an unworthy elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Even though you went out of your way to 
run for us...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't act as a wall to test you. So 
that you won't trip over unseen pebbles in 
the future—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to teach it to you. 
Exhilaration, humiliation, despair... all 
of it."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Sister of mine though she is, she truly 
inspires dread.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Do not have regrets. Sister... no, Dream 
Journey.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You've accomplished it. Didn't you show it 
in the race—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Staring ravenously at its prey, seeking to 
dominate through sheer presence...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—A power unknown to the King. You have 
done well to show it to me."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, none of it reaches Me. I have no 
need for lessons or learning.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Pebbles like that... can simply be crushed 
underfoot.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...I see. You're right."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"You are strong. For you... it was clear 
from the very beginning."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Orfe. Big Sis has a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Let's hear it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Take the world for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Show me the view from the summit.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...I am truly, so proud of you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: You will reach it. That endless dream—

text_block_list.name: Young Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Mom. Orfe is so adorable, isn't he? 
Even when he's asleep, he looks like an 
angel.”

text_block_list.name: Young Journey
text_block_list.text:
“This is my treasure. I'll take real good 
care of it, okay—?”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, don't worry, Mom. She's already 
asleep. Fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Mom. Her sleeping face hasn't 
changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Innocent, beautiful... and truly one of a 
kind in this world.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"She's definitely... going to become an 
amazing Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or will become our—no, everyone's dream. 
Until she reaches the destiny she 
deserves...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I will always support you. Orfe... my 
precious, most treasured King.
